about: measure contests of 2018 in New Jersey, in the layout of plan/PLAN.md section 3 with the fields data/README.md adds (D3). Built by pipeline/local_medsl.py from pipeline/intake/medsl_precinct.py's cache.

medsl.name: MIT Election Data and Science Lab, 2018 precinct-level returns, GitHub MEDSL/2018-elections-official at commit 42055b11dcd5
medsl.licence: no licence file in the repository; MEDSL's Dataverse sets of the same year are CC0 1.0
medsl.note: MEDSL's own earlier release, read by git (the repository now points to its Dataverse sets, which sit behind a guestbook; pipeline/intake/medsl_precinct.py --compare-dataverse matches the files by MD5); added up to the contest by pipeline/intake/medsl_precinct.py, files 2018-nj-precinct-general.zip

model.name: the model's own forecast, method D3-v1.1
model.note: each year forecast from a fit on earlier years only; no polls are used

nara.name: National Archives, Electoral College Results (the sitting president's party)
nara.licence: US federal public record; no licence printed

klarner.name: Carl Klarner, State Legislative Election Returns, 1967-2022, Harvard Dataverse doi:10.7910/DVN/FJOGJB, v1.0, released 2024-06-12T21:56:14Z (the races route (a) is fitted on)

census_places.name: U.S. Census Bureau, 2020 Census: national_place_by_county2020.txt (each place once for each county it lies in; codes2020 reference files)
census_places.licence: a work of the U.S. Government (17 U.S.C. 105); no licence printed

census_cousub.name: U.S. Census Bureau, 2020 Census: national_cousub2020.txt (each county subdivision with its county; codes2020 reference files): towns and townships with a government of their own (FUNCSTAT A), which nest within their county, and the names that are both a place's and a subdivision's
census_cousub.licence: a work of the U.S. Government (17 U.S.C. 105); no licence printed
